mapper.insert: insert into mvcboard2 (bname, bpass, btitle, bcontent, bdate, bip, bimg) values(#{bname}, #{bpass}, #{btitle}, #{bcontent}, now(), #{bip}, #{bimg})
mapper.update: update mvcboard2 set btitle=#{btitle}, bcontent=#{bcontent}, bimg=#{bimg} where bno=#{bno} and bpass=#{bpass}
update mvcboard2 set bhit = bhit+1 where bno=#{bno}
mapper.delete: delete from mvcboard2 where bno=#{bno} and bpass=#{bpass}
mapper.select: select * from mvcboard2 order by bno desc
select count(*) from mvcboard2 where bno=#{bno} and bpass=#{bpass}
select * from mvcboard2 order by bno desc limit #{start}, #{end}
